id.description: The host's user_id, ensuring one world per host.

world_name.description: The name of the world, set by the host.

world_data.description: A JSON object containing all world state, including players, map, NPCs, etc.

database.instructions: To manage a world, upsert a record into the 'worlds' table with the 'id' field set to your user_id. The 'world_data' field should contain all game state. All clients connect to the host, and only the host can authoritatively update this record.
